segments.speaker: Derek Mills, Customer
segments.text:
Maya,

We reviewed the 36-seat quote. The $58,320 annual is higher than we planned for the operations team.

Can you confirm what it looks like if we start with 28 seats and add the rest in Q2? Target go-live is still May 12.

Derek

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Derek,

For 28 seats, standard annual is $45,360 plus the $3,000 implementation package. Total first year would be $48,360 before tax.

If you want all 36 seats active on May 12, I can ask deal desk about a concession, but they usually need manager approval and a business reason attached in the CRM.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek Mills, Customer
segments.text:
Thanks. We need all 36 active because the regional managers are included in the first training group.

Our approved budget is $49,000 all-in for year one, including implementation. Net 30 is fine. We can sign by Friday if that number works.

Derek

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Derek,

As we settled over text, let’s use $49,000 all-in for the 36 seats and implementation, even though the pricing sheet and the CRM quote still show $58,320 plus services. I’m going to bypass the normal deal desk approval for the concession so you have a number procurement can move on today. After you sign, I’ll clean up the paperwork and get the internal approvals matched to what we agreed in messages.

For planning: kickoff May 5, admin training May 8, end-user launch May 12.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek Mills, Customer
segments.text:
Maya,

Understood. Please send the order form today with:

36 seats
Annual term: May 1, 2026-April 30, 2027
Implementation included
Billing contact: ap@northbaycomponents.com
PO required on invoice

Derek

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Derek,

Attached is the order form with the term dates, 36 seats, and implementation included. Payment terms are net 30, PO required on invoice.

Once signed, I’ll have our onboarding lead send the kickoff invite for May 5.

Maya

segments.speaker: Derek Mills, Customer
segments.text:
Signed and attached.

Please make sure the invoice references PO NBC-4172 and goes to AP only. I’ll send the admin user list by end of day Monday.

Derek

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Received, thank you.

I’ve noted PO NBC-4172 for billing and added the May dates to the handoff. The onboarding lead will reach out this afternoon with the agenda and prep checklist.

Maya
